_comment: Target-local mutation run over three pure, hermetic, high-risk enclave slices: orchestrator/router.ts (agent provider/model SELECTION + provider-diverse FALLBACK ordering — security/correctness: a wrong hard-gate or fallback bug routes a private-modality subtask to a model that cannot perform it, or loses provider diversity), media/provenance.ts (media PROVENANCE — private-taint propagation, TTL expiry, sha256 integrity, signature verify; a return-true/flip mutant here would leak a private-derived asset to a provider or accept a tampered/expired record), and dream/model-routing.ts (dream reconcile model ESCALATION on likely conflict — wrong escalation silently reconciles conflicting memories with a weaker model). All three are pure (no node:* beyond crypto hashing, no vsock, no network, no DB), so they run hermetically. Report-only / not wired into the shared adjusted-gate while parallel mutation sessions are open. See docs/quality/mutation-triage/enclave-provider-media-dream.md.
